Pharaoh's cupbearer and baker offended him, and were put in the prison where Joseph was held. Joseph attended them.
One night each man had a dream. In the morning Joseph saw their faces were downcast, and asked: why are you sad today?
They said: we dreamed, and no one can explain it. Joseph said: interpretations belong to God. Tell me.
The cupbearer dreamed of a vine with three branches, and he put Pharaoh's cup into Pharaoh's hand.
Joseph said: in three days Pharaoh will restore you. Then he asked: remember me, and speak for me. I did nothing to deserve this prison.
The baker dreamed of three baskets on his head, and birds eating from the top one.
Joseph said: in three days Pharaoh will have you executed.
On the third day, Pharaoh's birthday, it happened just as Joseph had said.
Joseph was a prisoner himself, yet he noticed two downcast faces. He stopped, and asked what was wrong.
Being forgotten hurts. It does not make kindness worth less.
Kindness given while you are hurting is still kindness.
Today, notice who around you looks heavy, and ask.
Who around you looks downcast right now?
